additions.name: China Telecom Lingang Information Park Phase 2.1

status.summary: Contractor September 14 report confirms Phase 2.1 main structures have topped out. This is a dated confirmation of achieved shell state; the exact recent topping-out day remains unknown. Data center, supporting machine room and 220 kV substation are the stated scope. No completion, operation or Phase 2.2 status is inferred.

locator.precision: Approximate representative point inside the named Phase 2 parent property, rounded to four decimals. It does not locate the Phase 2.1 buildings, active work, entrance, surveyed centroid, parcel boundary or Phase 1 property.
locator.identity_review: CSCEC explicitly confirms Phase 2.1. The authority-approved Phase 2 plan names the same project and shows a unique property east of Runhe Road, west of Yebo Road, south of Canghong Road and north of Zongqi River. The consultation drawing confirms these four limits. Runhe/Canghong and Runhe/Zhoude junctions anchor the plan, with Runhe/Danyi withheld as a check. No Phase 1 F07-01 point is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The plan and community road map provide no measured absolute accuracy. Two fit controls and the withheld check are collinear; the official north-up 1:750 plan supports isotropic scale, but the 8.44 m residual does not independently verify east-west or absolute ground accuracy. Rounded point denotes only the broad Phase 2 property.

additions.distinctness_review: All 430 baseline project/source records checked for Lingang, 临港, Runhe, 润荷 and F03-03; no matches. All 406 site coordinates checked; nearest baseline site is National AI Computing Center, Solaseado (Haenam) at 592.84 km. One named Phase 2 property and one Phase 2.1 project; no extra building or Phase 2.2 count.
additions.successor_review: Bounded October 14 primary contractor and indexed project searches recovered the same September 14 achieved-shell confirmation. September 30 B1/C1a MEP procurement and October utility-service procurement leads do not prove achieved completion or operation and are not used to advance status.
